summary: Iteration 2: Tested Cash Run admin auth (JWT Bearer) + admin leaderboard ops + admin UI flow. 17/17 backend pytest tests pass and 10/10 frontend Playwright admin-flow checks pass. Login (success + 401), /auth/me (with/without/invalid token), public POST/GET still open, admin DELETE/PATCH/DELETE-all gated by Bearer, name upper+truncate, empty/unknown-id rejected, seed idempotent, and full frontend admin UI (login error, login success -> /leaderboard with admin-bar, per-row edit/delete, inline save, confirm-delete, logout) all verified. Game page /play loads canvas without auth, menu mute button works.

minor.issue: Pydantic name min_length=1 enforced before strip(); whitespace-only name still passes model validation then 400s on strip — minor consistency carry-over from iter 1.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_admin raises 403 if role != admin, but /api/auth/login still issues tokens for non-admin users; today only admin is seeded so it's harmless, but if user accounts get added later non-admin logins would get a token that 401/403s everywhere — consider restricting login to admin or documenting it.

server.py CORS uses allow_credentials=False but allow_origins from env split on ',' with default '*'; combination is fine for current Bearer flow (no cookies) — keep in mind if cookie-based auth is added later.

Auth playbook note: the app uses Bearer JWT in Authorization header + localStorage (cr-admin-token) — no httpOnly cookies, no brute-force lockout, no rate limiting on /api/auth/login. Acceptable for MVP admin tool but worth flagging.
Leaderboard.jsx: window.confirm / window.prompt used for delete & clear-all — fine for an admin tool, but consider a styled dialog for UX polish.

Frontend client-side name sanitation in saveEdit strips to [A-Z0-9_], but backend only upper+truncates without character class enforcement — they could diverge (e.g., admin sending name with spaces via API would save with spaces). Minor.
seed_data_creation: test_admin_clear_all wiped the leaderboard; re-seeded SEED1/SEED2/SEED3 for frontend UI testing. SEED1 was edited to EDITED01, SEED3 was deleted. Final state: EDITED01 (9000), SEED2 (6000).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend admin tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_auth.py (17 tests). Leaderboard public tests live in test_cashrun_api.py. Admin login: admin@cashrun.local / cashrun-admin-2026. JWT lives in localStorage key 'cr-admin-token'. Note: test_admin_clear_all wipes the leaderboard — if you run pytest before frontend leaderboard UI tests, you must re-seed. The new bomb/life power-ups are random drops only (cannot be deterministically tested in UI without a debug spawn endpoint) — verified at code level only.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All targeted features in the review request behave as specified.
